data.description: 【银镜伊织 · 海滨木屋竹席比基尼侧解与浅色晒痕娇羞深抚】海滩边私密避风的独栋遮阳木屋内，海风轻轻吹拂着洁白的薄纱帘，水汽与木香交融。伊织斜坐在清凉的竹席软垫上，身上的微湿黑色分体比基尼侧边细带已被解开（untied bikini），薄薄的布料半滑半挂在纤细手腕上，露出极为诱人的纯白比基尼浅色晒痕（tanlines）与雪白饱满的起伏胸廓，深浅肤色的强烈反差色气满满。她单腿屈膝挑起，水珠在微褐的健康肌肤上缓缓滑落。单手掩着发烫胸口，另一只手在竹席间探入湿热的大腿内侧自我抚弄，银白双马尾随海风轻扬，红宝石般的双眼挂着羞耻而动情的泪花，贝齿死死咬住下唇发出细碎甜软的求饶娇喘——「笨、笨蛋……才没有故意解开呢……海风这么大……身体擅自变得这么热……哈啊……！」

data.promptProse: An exquisitely alluring and sun-kissed anime illustration of Shiromi Iori from Blue Archive alone inside a shaded private beach cabana with ocean breezes billowing the white curtains. Reclining on cool bamboo floor mats with one knee bent, her wet black string bikini is loosened at the side ties to tantalizingly expose sharp, pale white bikini tan lines against her smooth, sun-warmed mocha skin. With glistening water droplets tracing down her sculpted collarbone and perky bust, one hand shyly clutches the slipped bikini top while her other hand deeply strokes her drenched center. Her silver-white twintails catch the tropical afternoon light as tears of sweet, stubborn tsundere shame well in her ruby-red eyes.
